extracted.name: Sausage-Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
extracted.description: Stuffed with pork sausage, shredded and ricotta cheeses, onions and sun-dried tomatoes, these tasty mushroom caps are a sure crowd pleaser.
ingredient_lines: 1 (9.6 ounce) package Jimmy Dean® Original Hearty Pork Sausage Crumbles
2 cups shredded Italian cheese blend, divided
3 tablespoons finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes, rehydrated
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Combine sausage, 1 cup shredded cheese, ricotta cheese, onions and tomatoes in large bowl.
Brush tops of mushroom caps with oil; place, top-sides down, in shallow baking pan.
Top with sausage mixture. Drizzle with vinegar, if desired. Sprinkle with remaining shredded cheese.
Bake 10-12 minutes or until mushrooms are tender.
